findings.evidence_kind: original B entry execution plus retained private decompilation
findings.before: Plane-side tolerance was incorrectly treated as vertex snapping, followed by sorted interval clipping; original chooses edges using tolerant tetrahedron signs and allows edge-line extrapolation.
findings.fix: Use original tolerant edge selection, glam Mat4 determinant and edge-plane arithmetic; retain emitted endpoint order and finite checks.
findings.validation: 304 new original-entry cases and 257 prior cases pass classification and ordered endpoint checks; bounds on numerical residual remain explicit.

findings.evidence_kind: original native query fixture and source dependency audit
findings.before: Candidate hand-coded sorted-slice binary search, duplicating std.
findings.fix: Use slice::partition_point(value <= u); preserve original right bias, clamps and segment interpolation.
findings.validation: 41 original Curve2 inputs / 328 coord-position-tangent samples, including repeated and short segments, still pass exact bit checks.

findings.evidence_kind: PDB typed instantiations and current authoritative interface audit
findings.gap: Thresholded3D length/sampling policy is not implemented. Curve3 query policies, transform required-component wiring, source schema and caller closure policies are not fully recovered. Candidate source existence is not full original interface validation.
findings.fix: Requires original type/consumer evidence; no invented substitution or placeholders added.

findings.gap: reverse reverses then clones all points and reallocates cumulative lengths, adding O(n) copy and two allocations. Original observed entry also clones; therefore this is a potential optimization, not an original behavior mismatch.
findings.fix: Kept unchanged pending actual consumer hot-path evidence; no speedup claim.
